level1.prompt: Sam with a crush or a partner is…

options.t: Clingy mode: wants to see them daily and share every detail.
Solo mode: loves hard, still guards solo nights and bestie nights.

level1.prompt: You show Sam the angry text you're about to send. Bad idea. Sam…

options.t: "I get why you're mad." Holds you first, talks you down later.

level1.prompt: Picture Sam's future home on a big holiday. It's…

options.t: A remix: their own rituals, their own rules, no template.
The classic: rituals, the family table, parents at ease.

level1.prompt: Sam gets a surprise bonus. By Friday…

options.t: A flight is booked. Life is short.

level1.prompt: Talking plans and life progress, Sam is…

options.t: Unbothered: who gets promoted or married when is not their business.
Ambitious: wants real wins and a direction, soon.

level1.prompt: Lines, house rules, what's fair: Sam is…

options.t: Rulebook: the same rules for everyone is the only fair way.
Case by case: rules are fixed, people aren't.

cards.prompt: Genii bets there's a friend Sam stopped inviting, just to see if the friend ever invites them. True?
cards.a: Invites whoever Sam misses. Tests are exhausting.
cards.b: Three months in, still waiting, still counting.

cards.prompt: Last time Sam wanted the pricier version of something they owned plenty of already. How did it end?
cards.a: Bought it on the spot. Always room for one more.
cards.b: Left it in the cart until the feeling passed.

cards.prompt: The last time someone scrolled their phone while Sam was talking. How did Sam handle it?
cards.b: Kept talking like they hadn't noticed.

cards.prompt: A relative recently asked Sam: "can you help me with something?" What did Sam actually do?
cards.a: Said yes before the relative finished the sentence.
cards.b: Said yes for Saturday. Not every Saturday.

cards.prompt: Sam's last big message: a breakup, a resignation, a real apology. Who actually wrote it?
cards.a: An AI drafted it. I changed three words. Sent.
cards.b: Me. Nine drafts. Sent the tenth.

cards.prompt: Has Sam ever felt a little relieved when a friend's big plan flopped in public?
cards.a: Guilty. We'd been neck and neck. Now we weren't.
cards.b: Never. I don't track friends' plans that closely.

cards.prompt: Friends planned a trip that was a stretch for Sam's budget. What did Sam actually do?
cards.a: Booked it that night. Future me can deal.
cards.b: Did the math, then said "next one."

cards.prompt: Sam's partner recently had a weekend of plans without Sam. How did Sam spend it?
cards.a: Tagged along for part of it anyway.
cards.b: Booked my own plans before they'd even left.

cards.prompt: Someone new wants into Sam's friend group. Sam's best friend gives one honest tip. Which one?
cards.a: "Give it a year. They don't hand out trust."
cards.b: "Just show up. They'll adopt you by dessert."

cards.prompt: Has Sam ever said yes to one job or school offer while secretly hoping another would call?
cards.a: Guilty. Would do it again. A yes in hand is a yes.
cards.b: Guilty. Bailed on the first one when the other called.

cards.prompt: Sam's new housemate is a mermaid with a sunken ship's worth of gold, and wants rent split fifty-fifty. What does Sam do?
cards.b: Pitch it: we each pay by what we have.

cards.prompt: Same holiday photo, same stairs, 25 years running. Sam is abroad, and the family wants them photoshopped in. What does Sam do?
cards.a: Sends a selfie at the exact angle. The stairs must be honored.
cards.b: Sends a beach photo instead. New tradition starts now.

level3.prompt: Which of these 12 are the real Sam? Pick 4.

cards.name: Values family advice
cards.heart: My family is part of my 'we', and I like it that way.

cards.name: Writes without AI
cards.heart: My messy real words are the truest version of me.

cards.name: Uses AI to think things out
cards.heart: Feeling understood counts, wherever it comes from.

cards.name: Replies when free
cards.heart: Missing you doesn't need a daily check-in.

cards.name: Puts feelings into words
cards.heart: If I feel it, you're going to read it.

cards.name: Likes plans set early
cards.heart: Wanting solid ground is how I take care of myself.

cards.name: Goes with the flow
cards.heart: My timeline is mine to write.

cards.name: Makes room for exceptions
cards.heart: I look at the person, not the form.

cards.name: Loves a win
cards.heart: Wanting to build something big isn't too much.

cards.name: Loves hearing from friends
cards.heart: Wanting to be thought of isn't embarrassing.

cards.name: Work stays at work
cards.heart: A good life is the whole point, not the reward for later.

cards.name: Proud of hard work
cards.heart: I like knowing I earned my spot.

stingPick.prompt: Which of these 4 lines would leave Sam speechless for three seconds?

lines.t: You love being in their whole day, so the days apart drag.
You'll say yes to one more good cause before you say yes to a nap.
No script means every choice at home is yours to make, and to explain.
An AI may have heard more about your feelings than your friends have.

pickTheRoast.prompt: Pick the roast Sam would laugh at hardest.

lines.t: Asked for a quick opinion once. Got notes, bullet points and a follow-up.
Made a spreadsheet for the group trip. It has tabs. Plural.
Answers texts on a three-to-five business day schedule. Still my favorite.
Says 'we're keeping it casual.' Already knows their coffee order by heart.
Calls it 'just a side project.' It has a logo and a five-year plan.
Bragged about a $12 dupe for a full week. Unprompted.
